svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Capital Leaves
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-release-decision-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Capital Leaves; subtitle: All four checks must pass; unresolved evidence means no release, not a higher-priced exception.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Render four sequential decision nodes with pass and fail branches described in each detail. Numeric values indicate decision order, not risk scores. State examples illustrate jurisdiction-specific analysis and are not nationwide exemptions.; caption: Federal business-purpose treatment, state lending authority, escrow safety, and usable liquidity are separate questions. Passing one never substitutes for passing the remaining three.; stages: label: Commercial purpose and transaction substance; value: Pass documented business-purpose facts; stop unsupported classifications.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 1603(1) and 12 CFR 1026.3(a) to the actual credit purpose where relevant. An LLC borrower alone does not establish business purpose. If consumer-purpose facts emerge, stop this commercial workflow and assess the applicable consumer regime.; label: State authority, charges, and security; value: Pass verified licensing and charge analysis; stop unresolved scope.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Identify relevant state connections and document the applicable license or exemption. Examine California Financial Code section 22100 when applicable; examine New York General Obligations Law section 5-501 and Penal Law section 190.40 when applicable. Include origination and fixed fees in the legally required charge analysis. UCC 9-109(d)(11) prevents treating an ordinary Article 9 filing as a substitute for real-property security.; label: Escrow authority and unconditional buyer cash; value: Pass verified agent and cash evidence; stop dry closings.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify settlement-agent licensing where required, current bond or coverage evidence, beneficiary ownership, and independently confirmed buyer cash. Check coverage limits and exclusions rather than assuming every fraud loss is covered. Conditional deposits, changed bank details, or missing payoff authority stop disbursement.; label: Permitted liquidity and repayment control; value: Pass actual facility terms; stop promotional-rate assumptions.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify issuer-permitted use, cash-transfer eligibility, transaction fees, available limits, and repayment dates. Keep applications and proof-of-funds statements accurate; 18 U.S.C. 1014 applies to covered false statements. If promotional pricing expires before a credible payoff buffer, or repayment depends on new borrowing, reject that source and use an independently acceptable facility.

text.title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Capital Leaves
text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Capital Leaves

circle.title: label: Commercial purpose and transaction substance; value: Pass documented business-purpose facts; stop unsupported classifications.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 1603(1) and 12 CFR 1026.3(a) to the actual credit purpose where relevant. An LLC borrower alone does not establish business purpose. If consumer-purpose facts emerge, stop this commercial workflow and assess the applicable consumer regime.

text.title: Apply 15 U.S.C. 1603(1) and 12 CFR 1026.3(a) to the actual credit purpose where relevant. An LLC borrower alone does not establish business purpose. If consumer-purpose facts emerge, stop this commercial workflow and assess the applicable consumer regime.

circle.title: label: State authority, charges, and security; value: Pass verified licensing and charge analysis; stop unresolved scope.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Identify relevant state connections and document the applicable license or exemption. Examine California Financial Code section 22100 when applicable; examine New York General Obligations Law section 5-501 and Penal Law section 190.40 when applicable. Include origination and fixed fees in the legally required charge analysis. UCC 9-109(d)(11) prevents treating an ordinary Article 9 filing as a substitute for real-property security.

text.title: Identify relevant state connections and document the applicable license or exemption. Examine California Financial Code section 22100 when applicable; examine New York General Obligations Law section 5-501 and Penal Law section 190.40 when applicable. Include origination and fixed fees in the legally required charge analysis. UCC 9-109(d)(11) prevents treating an ordinary Article 9 filing as a substitute for real-property security.

circle.title: label: Escrow authority and unconditional buyer cash; value: Pass verified agent and cash evidence; stop dry closings.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify settlement-agent licensing where required, current bond or coverage evidence, beneficiary ownership, and independently confirmed buyer cash. Check coverage limits and exclusions rather than assuming every fraud loss is covered. Conditional deposits, changed bank details, or missing payoff authority stop disbursement.

text.title: Escrow authority and unconditional buyer cash

Verify settlement-agent licensing where required, current bond or coverage evidence, beneficiary ownership, and independently confirmed buyer cash. Check coverage limits and exclusions rather than assuming every fraud loss is covered. Conditional deposits, changed bank details, or missing payoff authority stop disbursement.

circle.title: label: Permitted liquidity and repayment control; value: Pass actual facility terms; stop promotional-rate assumptions.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify issuer-permitted use, cash-transfer eligibility, transaction fees, available limits, and repayment dates. Keep applications and proof-of-funds statements accurate; 18 U.S.C. 1014 applies to covered false statements. If promotional pricing expires before a credible payoff buffer, or repayment depends on new borrowing, reject that source and use an independently acceptable facility.

text.title: Verify issuer-permitted use, cash-transfer eligibility, transaction fees, available limits, and repayment dates. Keep applications and proof-of-funds statements accurate; 18 U.S.C. 1014 applies to covered false statements. If promotional pricing expires before a credible payoff buffer, or repayment depends on new borrowing, reject that source and use an independently acceptable facility.

Assumptions: Render four sequential decision nodes with pass and fail branches described in each detail. Numeric values indicate decision order, not risk scores. State examples illustrate jurisdiction-specific analysis and are not nationwide exemptions.
